title: Melatonin for Treatment of Delirium in Critically Ill Adult Patients
official: DELIRE-ICU: A Randomised Controlled Feasibility Trial of Melatonin vs Placebo in the Treatment of Delirium in the Intensive Care Unit
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the feasibility of conducting a randomized controlled trial (RCT) with melatonin for treatment of delirium in critically ill adult patients. From a feasibility perspective, the investigators believe that the proposed design will achieve the minimum enrollment rate necessary to conduct a future RCT on a larger scale.
sponsor: Ciusss de L'Est de l'Île de Montréal
